facts.fact: StackAdapt was named one of the Ad Age Best Places to Work 2024, marking the third consecutive year it has been honoured in the rankings.
facts.quote: This marks the third consecutive year StackAdapt has been honoured in the rankings.

facts.fact: Ad Age Best Places to Work 2024 honours 50 companies.
facts.quote: Ad Age Best Places to Work 2024 honours 50 companies that did a standout job over the past year

facts.fact: In Ad Age's Best Places to Work 2024 scoring, employee survey responses make up 75% of the score and company policies and practices make up 25% of the score.
facts.quote: factors in employee responses on topics including pay and benefits and seven other core focus areas (75% of the score) and a company’s policies and practices ... (25% of the score).
